issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 03 requests Name, Straße and URL of all Zoos in the Gemeinde with Schluessel '09162000', but the solution (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql) only selects the name column. This mismatch between the task specification and the provided solution will confuse students and cause automated checks that verify selected columns to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification by selecting all requested columns. Update solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql to: SELECT name, strasse, url FROM Zoo WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162000'; Alternatively, if the intended output is only the name, update the problem statement to request only the name.
